decision.observed_event: Turn order: you, the fourth player, the dealer. The fourth player hits you twice: 14 bludgeoning damage. The dealer breaks off, snatches up what he can reach, and runs out through the south door, shouting blame at the others over his shoulder. Your turn.

improv_read.connection: Uktarl avoids personal risk; once blood is drawn he pushes the others in front of him.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit narrates only what the table resolved and hands the fight back.

public_brief.objective: Get out alive with what coin he can carry.
public_brief.tactic: Grab coins and run, blaming the others.
public_brief.visible_cue: The fourth player stands between Nik and the door.
public_brief.kit_focus: Turn order, the blows, the dealer fleeing; then hand Nik his turn.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: You are fastest. Then the fourth player is on you, smoke still rising off it. Two heavy blows land, hard as iron. The dealer scoops coins off the burning table and bolts through the south door.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: This is your fault, all of you! I told you to watch the door! I told you strangers bring trouble! Hold her off if you want, I am not dying in this hole for your stupidity!

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: I am not dying in this hole
